page.overview:
Who is Avamarivash?

Avamarivash was the male leader of a civilization which occupied the city of Kaleth sometime after the Force Wars on Tython. Known as the Great Warrior Poet, Avamarivash was a large sponsor of the arts and was quite a different leader than his eventual successor Maravada the Silent as he frequently bedded many women and erected monuments to the glory of his people after fighting vicious wars. A history of Avamarivash's reign could be found in the Chamber of Speech in Kaleth up until the Cold War-era and the Jedi Order's return to Tython.
